label: PF Backlog 607
title: Gap: store-registry discovery incomplete - 233/235 stores unclassified (no backend/tenant_scope/migration_status) + no store->DB table/relationship mapping (prereq for EDP-18)

brief.what_adds: Per-store classification + a completeness gate, then the store to table/relationship mapping that drives schema creation
brief.problem: EDP-02 registered 235 stores but never classified them (233 null) nor mapped them to DB tables

objective: Gap: store-registry discovery incomplete - 233/235 stores unclassified (no backend/tenant_scope/migration_status) + no store->DB table/relationship mapping (prereq for EDP-18)
acceptance_criteria: Slice A: all stores carry a classification (sensitivity/tenant_scope/backend/retention/recovery_tier/migration_status) - 236/236 via store_registry_classify.py
Slice A: completeness gate store_registry_check fails if any store lacks a full classification; wired in precheck fast + ci-cd-gates
Slice B: every store records a target (kind: table|file|derived|object-store; planned targets name the owning EDP item) - 237/237 via store_registry_map.py; the gate now also requires target
Slice B: relationships between stores/tables are recorded in Slice C when each domain's tables are designed (amended: relationships deferred from Slice B)
Slice C: domain tables/views/triggers/queries are created per the mapping via their owning EDP items (EDP-15/18/19/20/21)
Evidence: gate outputs (236 classified / 237 mapped) + negative tests (exit 1); language-rule OK; precheck fast PASS
in_scope: Gap: store-registry discovery incomplete - 233/235 stores unclassified (no backend/tenant_scope/migration_status) + no store->DB table/relationship mapping (prereq for EDP-18)
approach: Gap: store-registry discovery incomplete - 233/235 stores unclassified (no backend/tenant_scope/migration_status) + no store->DB table/relationship mapping (prereq for EDP-18)
verification: Slice A independently verified: 236/236 classified; negative test exit 1
Slice B independently verified: 237/237 targets; negative test exit 1 (target removed -> gate FAIL)
Remaining: Slice C (tables/views/triggers/queries by domain) + relationships

Slice C: relationships recorded (28 edges: tenancy for every tenant_id table + projects/runs/stages/attempts/artifacts/memory object refs) + migration_status reconciled with the schema (86 migrated / 143 retained (including file-retained config with recorded reason) / 12 pending (intake/builds/design not yet delivered)).

Slice C gate store_registry_relationships.py verifies: exists targets name a migration table, planned targets have a live owner, migration_status matches the target, relationship columns exist, and the audit triggers are present; wired into precheck fast + ci-cd-gates.
Negative tests: unknown target table -> exit 1; removed required edge (runs->projects/tenants) -> exit 1.
Reconciled truth: migration_status describes where data lives; table-exists-but-file-backed stores stay pending until their cutover (object-store metadata validated against artifacts/stored_objects).
Self-test baked into the gate: 3 negative scenarios (unknown table, removed required edge, status drift) fail closed on every precheck/CI run.
Expectation is derived from the schema (every tenant_id table must declare a tenancy edge); planned targets must name a readable owner; enum/status validation and retained-reason enforcement.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/discovery_engine.py (and discovery_panel.py) to auto-classify every store found by scanning: derive backend, tenant_scope, migration_status by inspecting each store's config/source; then map each store to its DB table + relationship (schema inference or declarative entries). Reuse config/store-registry.json as output target; add fields to existing entries instead of replacing.
dependency_findings: RELATED BI-PF-1294 (EDP-02): field schema must match; decide ownership of classification fields
BLOCKS EDP-18 (store->DB mapping is stated prereq)
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1294 likely touches same files (store-registry.json, discovery_engine.py) concurrently
Any schema-migration task may read mapping mid-flight
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1294 (EDP-02) already extends store-registry.json with sensitivity/tenant_scope/backend/retention/migration_status - overlap must be split or subsumed
core/discovery_engine.py already enumerates stores; this adds classification layer, not re-scan
No existing DB-table mapping component found - genuinely new capability within existing engine
analysis.rationale: Genuine gap: 233/235 stores unclassified and no DB mapping, blocking EDP-18. Existing discovery engine and registry are natural extension points, so EXTEND fits; duplication risk with BI-PF-1294 is the main coordination concern.
assumptions: store-registry.json is the canonical registry for all stores
Backend/tenant_scope can be inferred from store config with heuristics plus allowlist override
EDP-18 exists in backlog and will consume mapping via store-registry.json
risks: Field-definition conflict with BI-PF-1294 causing duplicated/contradictory classification logic
Store->DB mapping may need manual annotation for stores with non-obvious data paths
Some stores may be dead/ephemeral, inflating effort
evidence: core/discovery_engine.py and core/discovery_panel.py exist as candidate components
config/store-registry.json currently classifies only 2 of 235 stores
BI-PF-1294 title explicitly names the same fields
missing_info: Relationship to BI-PF-1294: merge into one EDP-02 track or keep separate backend-only scope?
Mapping format for store->DB table (declarative JSON field vs. runtime schema-inference output)
Acceptable override mechanism (config file, code allowlist) for mis-inferred classifications
Whether dead/ephemeral stores should be marked or excluded from registry

context_review.reason: All fields merely repeat the title; no concrete registry location, schema, classification criteria, file paths, or implementation method are specified.

api_impact.reason: registry/tooling completion; no external consumer API

sig:4b9f32e80a71862e.note: Tenancy edges are derived from the schema; the projects/runs/stages/attempts chain is validated for existence/columns but not required. Tracked as a follow-up.

sig:ba4bac6e460e5632.note: SEED is only initial seeding for --apply; check-time authority is the registry + schema-derived tenancy expectation, so drift cannot pass the gate.

sig:596f9100157ebbb5.note: planned->exists requires the owning item completed AND the target verified (table in migrations, or object-store backend + artifacts/stored_objects metadata). Both are recorded facts, not self-asserted.

sig:6417afbcf5e988be.note: The 17 config targets were restored (ref tool_settings, owner kept) with an explicit retained_reason; empty ref is valid only for file-retained stores by design.

sig:64d6bf4ab3a8be05.note: A renamed trigger is a deliberate schema change and should fail the gate; provenance is the audit item (EDP-20).

sig:c0263e262c0576aa.note: Full failure output is intentional; the no-op flag will be removed in a tooling cleanup.

sig:4181fa3a9ab9585b.note: Backend is the Slice A discovery fact; schema + backend + owner status are independent enough for a discovery gate.

sig:92ded24794071743.note: Migrations use plain SQL for tables; dollar-quoted bodies are function bodies not table DDL.

sig:fa8b10231e33c44f.note: Naming is documented in the field comment; no collision with reason (which is absent on these targets).

sig:61bd32f109ebfac1.note: Documented: retained_reason is the explicit marker for file-backed config; any other file-backed table stays pending.

sig:2629dfd4ffd238ee.note: Object-store/trigger negative cases are a follow-up; three scenarios cover the observed failure modes.

sig:41eb03ed2e6d94f7.note: view/derived are derived artifacts over files; pairing with derived backend is intentional.
